standard-dialogue.npc: Hello! Glad to see you're okay. I was worried you might have gone and got stuck down that hole.

standard-dialogue.player: No need to worry. I'm mostly quite capable when it comes to these kinds of things!

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.text: If the player never spoke to Ramarno after completion of Below Ice Mountain:

steps.npc: Hello there. Did you see that dwarf by the big forge? I think he wanted to talk to you.

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.text: If the player spoke to Ramarno after completion of Below Ice Mountain:

steps.npc: Hello! Look at this place. Isn't it amazing?

steps.player: It sure is! Not every day you find yourself in a lost city.

steps.npc: So what can I do for you?

steps.player: Does the name Lassar mean anything to you? It was an old fortress that once existed here, long before Camdozaal. I'm wondering if there might still be some traces left down here.

steps.npc: A ruin within a ruin? How exciting! We have found the odd thing that doesn't seem to be dwarven in origin, but it's still early days for us here, so we haven't been able to learn much yet.
One that was particularly interesting was this strange icon I found in the mine.

steps.text: The archaeologist shows you an unusual icon.

steps.npc: Could be a lot more to find over there, but I must admit, I haven't been back since... well...
It's probably nothing, but there's this big sinkhole on the other side of the mine. I'm probably just being silly, but I'm sure I heard a voice coming from inside.

steps.player: Interesting... And if I wanted to go down this hole?

steps.npc: Go down the hole?! You're far braver than I am! There's plenty of rocks around there. I'm sure you could tie a rope to one of them. You'd need a pretty long rope though. Here, you can use mine.

steps.text: The archaeologist gives you some rope.
